description: This file defines the CRS (Coordinate Reference Systems) object for the Leaflet mapping library, including methods for projecting and unprojecting geographical coordinates, scaling, zoom calculations, and bounds transformations.

methods.name: latLngToPoint
methods.description: Projects geographical coordinates into pixel coordinates for a given zoom level.

methods.name: pointToLatLng
methods.description: Projects pixel coordinates back into geographical coordinates for a given zoom level.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Projects geographical coordinates into coordinate units accepted by the CRS.

methods.name: unproject
methods.description: Converts projected coordinate units back into geographical coordinates.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Calculates the scale factor for a given zoom level.

methods.name: zoom
methods.description: Calculates the zoom level from a scale factor.

methods.name: getProjectedBounds
methods.description: Returns the bounds of the projection at a specific zoom level.

methods.name: wrapLatLng
methods.description: Wraps latitude and longitude to within the CRS bounds.

methods.name: wrapLatLngBounds
methods.description: Ensures bounds are within the CRS bounds, adjusting center as needed.
